title: Modbus register map
description: The Modbus interface of one device: transport limits and the register map. A register is an entity here rather than an attribute of a property, which is what lets one register carry several properties as bits, one property span several registers, and a range be reserved carrying nothing at all -- none of which a per-property binding could express (D15). Properties are referenced by name from the properties document.

limits.description: Transport-level facts about what this device tolerates, as opposed to what Modbus permits.

identifier.description: Also has to be a valid C identifier: the firmware X-macro pastes these into token names.

register.description: One register, or a reserved range of them.

allOf.description: A reserved range carries nothing; anything else carries something.
A register carrying more than one property needs its own name: there is no single property to borrow one from.

space.description: Which Modbus address space. These are independent ranges: the same number in two spaces is two different registers.

title.description: The register's name in the register map. Optional when it carries exactly one property, which lends its title.

description.description: Prose for the register map. A register carrying several properties has no property to borrow this from, which is the reason registers are entities here.

access.description: Whether a client may write this register. A fact about the register: eight bools packed into a status word are read-only because the register is.

reserved.description: Why this range carries nothing: reserved for future use, withdrawn, vendor-private. The prose is the point -- a bare gap is indistinguishable from an oversight.

field.description: One property carried by this register, either whole or as a single bit.

property.description: Name of the property in the properties document.

encoding.description: How the value is packed. A width wider than one register makes this register span the following addresses too.

bit.description: Bit position, for a bool packed into this register. No encoding is given: a bit is a bit.

count.description: Element count for an array or a string. Array length, not register span.
